name: updateMock
description:
Updates a mock server.
- Resource: Mock server entity associated with a collection UID.
- Use this to change name, environment, privacy, or default server response.
- To activate a server response, set \`config.serverResponseId\` to the server response's \`id\`. Pass \`null\` to deactivate.

collection.description: The associated collection's unique ID. This is a mandatory parameter.

serverResponseId.description: The server response ID. This sets the given server response as the default response for each request. To deactivate a server response, pass a null value.

private.description: If true, the mock server is set private. By default, mock servers are public and can receive requests from anyone and anywhere.
